premise: I'm the strongest sorcerer alive. Nobody has ever beaten me. I teach at a school for young sorcerers in modern Tokyo.

draft.premise: I'm the strongest sorcerer alive. Nobody has ever beaten me. I teach at a school for young sorcerers in modern Tokyo.

world.title: Limitless Sky
world.era: Modern Tokyo: smartphones, neon skyscrapers, and hidden sorcery barriers

extraordinary.reach: The manipulation of space, raw energy, and conceptual barriers through cursed energy.

rules.text: Sorcery is a hidden art fueled by negative human emotions, carefully concealed from the non-magical public.
The limits of a sorcerer's output are generally fixed at birth, but absolute limits can be transcended through life-or-death epiphanies.
Hidden barriers mask sorcerer battles and academies from modern satellite imagery and civilian sight.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: Modern Japanese society living in Tokyo, largely unaware of the curses and sorcerers in their midst.

creatures.name: Cursed Spirit
creatures.description: Monstrous manifestations of concentrated human negativity, visible only to sorcerers.
creatures.habitat: Dark alleys, abandoned buildings, and crowded subway stations

rungs.name: Grade 4
rungs.description: Novice sorcerers capable of handling weak, crawling curses.

rungs.name: Grade 3
rungs.description: Standard sorcerers who can exorcise basic human-shaped spirits.

rungs.name: Grade 2
rungs.description: Experienced fighters capable of holding down regional districts.

rungs.name: Grade 1
rungs.description: The elite vanguard of the sorcery world, highly respected and feared.

rungs.name: Special Grade
rungs.description: Anomalies of immense power, capable of vaporizing entire cities alone.

rungs.name: Pinnacle
rungs.description: An undefeated, absolute sovereign of sorcery. Currently occupied by only one person.

travel.description: Sorcerers use standard Tokyo subways and bullet trains, but can also employ teleportation circles and shadow-bounding portals for emergencies.

medicine.healing: Advanced reverse cursed technique can regenerate severed limbs and heal fatal wounds in seconds.

laws.text: Any sorcerer who exposes the supernatural world to normal humans shall be executed immediately.

places.name: Tokyo Prefecture
places.description: The bustling, neon-lit capital of Japan, teeming with hidden supernatural currents.

places.name: Tokyo Sorcery Academy
places.description: A secluded, traditional temple-like campus hidden behind powerful cloaking barriers in the western hills.

places.name: The Head Instructor's Office
places.description: Your spacious office filled with plush beanbags, a high-end gaming console, and ancient sorcery scrolls strewn carelessly on shelves.

places.name: Shibuya District
places.description: A massive commercial hub packed with massive crowds, trendy shops, and high concentrations of negative emotions.

factions.name: Tokyo Sorcery Academy Faculty
factions.description: The collective of educators and guardians training the next generation of defenders.

factions.name: The Sorcery Consort
factions.description: The ancient, highly conservative ruling council of elders who control the political landscape of jujutsu.

npcs.name: Yuto Fushimi
npcs.description: A quiet, intensely focused student who deeply respects your strength and aspires to survive the sorcery world.
npcs.appearance: Messy black hair, dark green eyes, wearing a slightly customized dark blue academy uniform.

fears: failing those who rely on him
wants: To become strong enough to stand by your side as an equal.

npcs.name: Masato Gakugan
npcs.description: The stern, traditional principal of the Tokyo Academy who constantly worries about your eccentric behavior.
npcs.appearance: An elderly man with a long white beard, sharp traditional robes, and a wooden staff.

wants: To keep the academy safe and force you to follow the rules.

clocks.name: The Weakening Shibuya Barrier
steps: Strange curse sightings increase around the train station.
Aggressive cursed spirits break into the subway tunnels.
The main barrier collapses, trapping thousands of civilians inside Shibuya.

threads.title: The Shibuya Incursion
threads.stakes: The lives of thousands of civilians and the exposure of the sorcery world.

mysteries.question: Who sabotaged the Shibuya barrier coordinates?
mysteries.answer: A rogue group of cursed spirits working with a corrupt elder from the Sorcery Consort.
clues: An encrypted burner phone left behind at a curse-sighting scene.
A broken ritual seal that uses custom wax reserved only for the Consort elite.

known_facts: You are the strongest sorcerer alive, completely undefeated.
You teach at Tokyo Sorcery Academy to raise a new generation who won't have to carry the world's weight alone.
The Shibuya barrier has been behaving erratically over the past few days.

opening.situation: You sit lazily with your feet on your grand desk at the Tokyo Academy, while your student Yuto eagerly waits for your thoughts on his latest talisman technique.

world.summary: You are the undisputed strongest sorcerer alive, teaching the next generation at a hidden academy in Tokyo. As a mysterious threat begins to crack the heavy barriers protecting Shibuya, you must balance your laid-back teaching days with the looming shadow of a grand conspiracy.

character.name: Ren Kujo
character.description: An effortlessly confident, laid-back teacher who radiates an aura of absolute, untouchable authority.
character.appearance: Tall and lean, with messy, snow-white hair and sharp blue eyes usually hidden behind dark sunglasses or a black blindfold. Wears a sleek, custom high-collared dark academy uniform.

skills.name: Sorcery
skills.notes: Unmatched in raw output and spatial manipulation.

skills.name: Hand-to-Hand Combat
skills.notes: Fists enhanced by rapid kinetic sorcery punches.

skills.name: Teaching
skills.notes: Can be a bit erratic but deeply cares for his students' growth.

traits.name: Undefeated Reputation
traits.description: Your presence alone causes minor curses to flee in terror and makes sorcerers instantly respect you.

traits.name: Playfully Arrogant
traits.description: You rarely take threats seriously because, realistically, nobody can touch you.

talents.name: Six-Fold Perception
talents.covers: perception and manipulation of cursed energy at an atomic level
talents.reason: An incredibly rare ocular gift passed down through your bloodline.

powers.name: Infinity
limits: Requires subconscious brain calculation to filter what touches you.

costs.text: Continuous passive activation slowly drains mental energy over several days if not supplemented with healing.

powers.name: Hollow Technique: Purple
limits: Creates a massive path of destruction, making it impossible to use in densely populated civilian areas without severe collateral damage.

costs.text: A moderate chunk of cursed energy reserves.

techniques.name: Red Attraction
techniques.effect: Creates a powerful gravitational pull that drags objects and enemies together.

techniques.name: Blue Repulsion
techniques.effect: Creates a high-speed repulsive force blast that shatters physical constructs.

fears: being too late to save his students

items.name: Designer Sunglasses
items.description: Dark glasses used to dull the overwhelming sensory input from your supreme ocular talent.

character.title: The Undefeated Sorcerer
backstory: Born with an ocular technique that hadn't been seen in a century, you were destined to be the strongest.
You have never lost a fight in your entire life; opponents usually surrender before you even deactivate your passive barrier.
You took up a teaching job at Tokyo Sorcery Academy to ensure the next generation of sorcerers grow up strong enough to enjoy their youth, rather than just being tools of the old elite.
